help.title: Reading your Stellar
help.explore: Locate work in the tree, then follow its connections
help.domain: Select an area to focus on its groups.
help.group: Select a group to expand its issue nodes.
help.issue: Select an issue to see its classification path and direct connections.
help.history: Go back to revisit a view. Overview collapses groups for a wider perspective.
help.controls:
Drag: pan · Scroll: zoom · Shift+scroll: pan
F: fit · /: search · Esc: close
Save SVG: export the visible canvas.
help.classification: Grouping lines describe work purpose. They are separate from source parent-child relations.
help.direction: Blocking arrows point from prerequisite to dependent. Related links are undirected. Select an edge between collapsed groups to inspect its actual issue pairs.
help.targets: Target focus highlights matching work across areas. Sharing a target does not create a dependency.
help.context: Search includes all issues, including context. Neighbors distinguish context issues from assigned work outside the current status filter. Both use dashed borders and stay outside the current count.
help.rationale: Select an area, group or issue to read its classification rationale in the inspector.
help.snapshot: Snapshot: {timestamp}. This map does not update live.
export.saved: Saved the current canvas as SVG.
target.contextOnly: This target occurs only on context issues. There is no assigned work to highlight.
